text: タマタマは　ナッシーに　しんか　するぞ

structure.jp: ナッシーに　しんか　するぞ

patterns.name: 〜に (result)
patterns.span: ナッシーに　しんか　する
patterns.explanation: に with a verb of changing shows what something turns into. ナッシーに　しんか　する = 'evolves into Exeggutor'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end of a sentence is rough, mostly male talk that states something strongly. しんか　するぞ = 'it evolves, I tell you!'.
